title: Token payloads and headers, contract v1 (DRAFT v1-d4)
description: Pick the $defs entry for the client under test: access_token_cachd, access_token_other (org_claims off), access_token_other_org_claims (org_claims on), id_token_code, id_token_refresh, access_token_admin_super, access_token_admin_partner, jose_header_*. Claim lists [SRC: PLAN §3.1 L116-123; LD §5 L230, §16.5 L910-912]. Value types [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-15]. Time checks use ±30 s skew (G1) [TL Decision 2026-11-02, G1].

id.description: Opaque id, UUID string [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-15]. Pattern enforces UUID even if a validator has format assertion off [TL Decision 2026-11-02, CR-01]; validators MUST still run with format assertion on [TL Decision 2026-11-02, CR-21].

amr.description: Array [SRC: PLAN L118]. Closed enum, RFC 8176 values only; nothing passes through from Entra [TL Decision 2026-11-02, CR-02, OQ-22] (LD §16.19.3, row 119 L706). DB sign-in password+TOTP = [pwd, otp, mfa]; recovery-code sign-in = [pwd] (never MFA); Entra amr containing mfa or ngcmfa -> mfa; wiaormfa never -> mfa. Hand-off needs mfa [SRC: LD L1184; TL Decision 2026-11-02, CR-02]

standin_marker.description: Present (true) only on stand-in tokens [SRC: PLAN §3.5]. Rejected outside Development [SRC: PLAN S1 check 11].

no_roles_or_permissions.description: No roles or permissions in any token [SRC: PLAN L121; LD L912]. Names listed are the common ones; tests also assert no other unknown claim via unevaluatedProperties.

aud.description: That client's API only [SRC: PLAN L116]. A single string, only cash-advance-api or backoffice-api; no array [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-15, 8:12 PM reply].

scope.description: Space-separated (RFC 9068); values openid, cash_advance_api, backoffice_api [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-6].

client_id.description: OAuth client; never used for tenant scoping [SRC: LD §16.5 L910].

access_token_base.$comment: Lifetime 5 min: tests assert exp - iat == 300 [SRC: PLAN L116].

cachd_client_id.description: Absent for partner-level users [SRC: PLAN L120; LD L910].

location_id.description: The location picked at sign-in [SRC: LD L911]. Required for location sign-ins (/l/{slug}); absent (not null) for /admin tokens, see access_token_admin [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-15] (LD §16.19.2 L1430). Single value in tokens; audit uses the array scope.location_ids (contract 8.11) [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:26 PM].

access_token_cachd.description: Cachd clients (Cash Advance BFF): org claims always, perm_version [SRC: PLAN L119-120].

access_token_other.description: Non-Cachd client (e.g. backoffice_stub) with org_claims off: no perm_version, no org claims [SRC: PLAN L119-120, S1 check 7].

access_token_other_org_claims.description: Non-Cachd client with org_claims on: org claims, still no perm_version [SRC: LD §16.5 L911].

kid.description: Stand-in kids start with standin- [SRC: PLAN §3.5].

typ.description: RFC 9068; JwtBearer ValidTypes=["at+jwt"], so an ID token as bearer gets 401 [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-14].

id_token_base.description: Shared ID token shape [SRC: PLAN L122-123]. Lifetime 5 min [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-15]. Use id_token_code or id_token_refresh [TL Decision 2026-11-02, CR-03].

id_token_code.description: ID token from the authorization_code grant: nonce required [TL Decision 2026-11-02, CR-03] (OIDC Core §3.1.3.6).

id_token_refresh.description: ID token from the refresh_token grant: nonce absent [TL Decision 2026-11-02, CR-03] (OIDC Core §12.2).

access_token_admin_super.description: /admin, Super Admin: no location_id (absent) [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-15] (LD L1430); partner_id optional [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:26 PM].

access_token_admin_partner.description: /admin, Partner Admin: no location_id (absent) [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-15] (LD L1430); partner_id required [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:26 PM].

access_token_admin.description: Either /admin shape. Tokens carry no role claim, so a test picks _super or _partner by the fixture user it signed in as [TL Decision 2026-11-02 8:26 PM].
